name: Bearing
description: The central rotational part for wheels, steering joints, doors, arms, and moving mechanisms.

sections.heading: How Bearings Work
paragraphs: A Bearing creates a rotating connection between its base and the object attached to its moving side. Wheels use bearings to spin, while steering assemblies use them to change angle.
Bearings are locked while the creation is on the Lift. Remove the Lift before judging whether a joint moves correctly under physics.

sections.heading: Control Options
bullets: Connect an engine when the bearing should provide continuous driven rotation.
Connect a Driver's Seat when the bearing should respond to steering input.
Connect a Controller when the bearing needs a programmed angle or sequence.
Use the Connect Tool to inspect and reverse a connected bearing direction.

links.label: Calculate inner and outer steering angles
links.description: Convert wheelbase and steering-bearing spacing into separate Level 5 seat limits.

sections.heading: Common Build Mistakes
bullets: Attaching the moving body to the wrong face of the bearing.
Testing while the creation is still locked on the Lift.
Reversing one wheel or steering joint and not checking the connection arrows.

seo.description: Learn how Bearings create wheel rotation, steering joints, doors, and controlled movement in Scrap Mechanic builds. Review the connected uses.

name: Controller
description: A programmable interactive part that sequences connected Bearings and Pistons.

sections.heading: What a Controller Is For
paragraphs: The Controller is used when a moving part needs a repeatable position or sequence instead of free rotation. It can coordinate doors, folding sections, lifting arms, steering modes, and compact mechanisms.

sections.heading: Basic Setup
steps: Place the Controller on the same creation as the moving parts.
Use the Connect Tool to connect the Controller to each Bearing or Piston.
Connect a Switch, Button, Sensor, or Driver's Seat to activate the sequence.
Set each movement frame and test slowly before increasing speed.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
bullets: Check the numbered connection order before editing a long sequence.
Reverse a bearing connection if the mechanism moves the wrong way.
Reduce speed when a heavy mechanism shakes or collides with its own frame.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Controller Guide - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Set up a Scrap Mechanic Controller for Bearings, Pistons, timed sequences, doors, and moving build mechanisms. Check the related systems first.

name: Piston
description: A linear movement part used for lifts, presses, deployable tools, doors, and suspension experiments.

sections.heading: Where Pistons Fit
paragraphs: Pistons add controlled straight-line movement. They work well for compact lifts, deployable drills, gates, presses, stabilizers, and mechanisms that cannot be solved cleanly with rotation alone.

sections.heading: Build Safely
bullets: Leave enough clearance for the full extension.
Test the piston at low speed before attaching a heavy tool head.
Watch for parts that collide with the frame while retracting.

seo.description: Use Pistons for linear movement, lifts, doors, deployable tools, and controlled Scrap Mechanic mechanisms. Compare the practical requirements in-game.

name: Logic Gate
description: A signal-processing part used to combine inputs and build reliable automated behavior.
imageAlt: logic gate image from Scrap Mechanic

sections.heading: Start with One Decision
paragraphs: Logic builds become easier when every gate answers one clear question. Begin with a simple condition, confirm the output, and only then connect it to the next stage.

sections.heading: Good First Projects
bullets: A door that can be opened from either side.
A safety interlock that stops a machine while a gate is open.
A sensor-controlled watering pass.
A status light that shows whether a mechanism is ready.

name: Gas Engine
description: A fuel-powered engine for wheel bearings and other continuously driven rotational systems.
imageAlt: gas engine image from Scrap Mechanic

tables.caption: Gas Engine upgrade ladder (1.0 data)
tables.note: Reaching Level 5 costs 28 Component Kits in total. Higher power settings change available torque; test the setting again after every upgrade and load change.

sections.heading: Set Power for the Vehicle You Have
paragraphs: More engine power is not always more control. Begin at a low setting, test the unloaded chassis, then increase one step at a time after storage and tools are mounted.

Each level adds two bearing connections and increases the available power range, torque, and work per unit of Gasoline. Upgrade only when the current connection limit or loaded performance is the real constraint.
bullets: Connect only the bearings that should provide drive.
Reverse incorrect wheel direction with the Connect Tool.
Reduce power when acceleration causes rolling or wheel spin.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Gas Engine - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Connect and tune a Gas Engine for stable wheels, efficient fuel use, and controllable vehicles in Scrap Mechanic. Check the related systems first.

name: Electric Engine
description: A battery-powered engine for controlled vehicle drive and powered rotational mechanisms.
imageAlt: electric engine image from Scrap Mechanic

tables.caption: Electric Engine upgrade ladder (1.0 data)
tables.note: Reaching Level 5 costs 28 Component Kits in total. The Electric Engine setting controls target speed; Level 5 also exposes differential steering behavior.

sections.heading: Choose It as a System
paragraphs: An Electric Engine changes the supply chain from Gasoline to Batteries. Make the choice around available resources, vehicle job, and how often it must operate, not only around the first test drive.

Every upgrade adds two bearing connections and increases both the available speed settings and work per Battery. Treat Level 5 differential steering as a control option, not a substitute for correct wheel and bearing geometry.
bullets: Keep a separate battery reserve for essential transport.
Check every bearing direction before loading cargo.
Measure a real route before sizing the onboard supply.

seo.description: Plan battery supply and bearing connections for an Electric Engine vehicle in Scrap Mechanic. Check its connected uses before the next Survival run.

name: Thruster
description: A directional force part used for propulsion, stabilization, assisted jumps, and experimental vehicles.

facts.label: Main risk
facts.value: Force applied away from the center of mass

sections.heading: Force Needs Alignment
paragraphs: A Thruster pushes along its own axis. If that force misses the creation's center of mass, it also creates rotation, which can be useful for control or disastrous for a cargo vehicle.
bullets: Test one axis at a time with low power.
Mount matched thrusters symmetrically when stable motion is the goal.
Add a clear shutoff control before increasing power.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Thruster Setup - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Align and control Thrusters for propulsion, stabilization, and experimental Scrap Mechanic creations. Compare the practical requirements in-game.

name: Driver's Seat
description: The main player control part for driving, steering bearings, and activating connected vehicle functions.
imageAlt: drivers seat image from Scrap Mechanic

tables.caption: Driver's Seat upgrade ladder (1.0 data)
tables.note: Reaching Level 5 costs 11 Component Kits in total. Level 5 raises the connection ceiling to 20 and unlocks per-bearing steering settings.

sections.heading: Make Controls Readable
paragraphs: Connect steering bearings first, verify left and right, then add engines and auxiliary controls. A small labeled control set is easier to recover under pressure than a seat connected to every machine on the vehicle.

Upgrade the seat when its connection limit blocks the next control, or when Level 5 steering-angle settings solve a specific axle problem. A higher-level seat does not correct a reversed bearing by itself.
bullets: Keep steering separate from tool movement.
Place the seat near the vehicle center when practical.
Use paint or signs to identify important numbered controls.

links.label: Set Level 5 Driver's Seat bearing angles
links.description: Calculate the left and right limits for each front steering bearing.

name: Switch and Button
description: Basic signal inputs used to turn systems on, trigger actions, and give a mechanic direct control.

facts.label: Switch
facts.value: Maintains an on or off state

sections.heading: Choose the Correct Input Behavior
paragraphs: Use a Switch when a machine should remain active after the player steps away. Use a Button when the action should last only while triggered or start a controlled sequence.
bullets: Give dangerous machinery a reachable off control.
Label controls before a panel grows beyond two inputs.
Test the stopped state as carefully as the running state.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Switch and Button - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Choose Switches and Buttons for direct controls, safe shutoffs, and logic inputs in Scrap Mechanic. Compare the practical requirements in-game.

name: Sensor
description: An interactive detector used to trigger doors, machines, alarms, and automated actions.

sections.heading: Design the Detection Zone First
paragraphs: A Sensor is reliable only when its view and target are controlled. Build the doorway, crop row, or machine path first, then place the sensor where unrelated movement cannot trigger it.
bullets: Test from the edges of the intended detection area.
Use color settings only with a consistent paint convention.
Combine with a Logic Gate when one detection should not be enough.

seo.description: Configure Scrap Mechanic Sensors for doors, farm machines, alarms, and safe automated systems. Check its connected uses before the next Survival run.

name: Sport and Off-Road Suspension
description: Adjustable suspension parts that help wheels follow terrain and reduce shock transferred into a vehicle frame.

sections.heading: Tune the Loaded Vehicle
paragraphs: A suspension setting that works on an empty chassis may collapse under cargo or bounce after a tool is added. Tune with the normal operating load and test both road travel and a controlled obstacle.
bullets: Use matching settings across the same axle.
Leave physical clearance for full compression.
Lower the center of mass before making the suspension excessively stiff.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Suspension Tuning - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Tune Sport and Off-Road Suspension for wheel travel, cargo weight, and stable Scrap Mechanic vehicles. Compare the practical requirements in-game.

name: Big Wheel
description: A five-block-diameter vehicle wheel that adds ground clearance and a wider contact area for larger Scrap Mechanic builds.
imageAlt: Big Wheel item icon from Scrap Mechanic

sections.heading: Big Wheel Overview
paragraphs: The Big Wheel is a larger alternative to the standard Wheel. Its five-block diameter raises the axle and places more tread against the ground, which can help a cargo vehicle clear uneven terrain.
A Big Wheel does not rotate on its own. Mount each wheel on a Bearing, connect the drive bearings to an engine, and verify the direction of every connection before adding cargo.

sections.heading: Build and Tune the Axle
bullets: Leave clearance around the full five-block diameter through steering and suspension travel.
Use matching wheel, bearing, and suspension placement on both sides of an axle.
Test steering lock and body roll with the normal storage load installed.
Keep the axle low enough for stability while preserving the ground clearance the larger radius provides.

name: Vacuum Pump
description: A reversible logistics part used with containers and pipes to collect, plant, water, harvest, and move supported materials.
imageAlt: vacuum pump image from Scrap Mechanic

facts.label: Collects
facts.value: Water, Chemicals, Crude Oil, crops, and supported items

facts.label: Recipe
facts.value: 20 Metal 1 + 1 Component Kit + 1 Circuit Board + 3 Glue

tables.caption: Vacuum Pump mode by job
rows: Connected Water Container with free capacity
Plant seeds or place supported items
Move water to a farm system
Stored water and a valid delivery target
tables.note: The control signal starts the pump; it does not replace the required container, contents, pipe route, or target.

tables.caption: Vacuum Pump not working: isolate the failed stage
rows: Aim at one supported liquid or loose item
Correct container type and free capacity
Connect pump directly to one empty container
Load one seed or item and use a manual switch
Water rather than Chemicals or Oil
Test pump, container, then cannon separately
Works at one shoreline but not another
Intake height relative to liquid surface
Move a few metres and retest a clean edge

sections.heading: In Mode Collects; Out Mode Delivers
paragraphs: In mode pulls supported material toward connected storage. It can collect Water, Chemicals, and Crude Oil when the intake reaches the matching liquid, and it can move crops or supported loose items into a Chest.

Out mode takes supported contents from connected storage and sends them toward the target. Use it for planting, item placement, or the delivery side of a farm machine. Reversing the mode changes the job; it does not reverse an incompatible container.

sections.heading: Why a Vacuum Pump Will Not Pick Up Water
steps: Set the pump to In and connect a manual Button or Switch.
Connect it directly to an empty Water Container for the first test.
Place the intake at the liquid edge and adjust its height relative to the visible surface.
Trigger one short cycle and confirm the Water Container count changes.
Only after that works, add the longer Vacuum Pipe route, sensors, or a Water Cannon.

sections.heading: Water, Chemicals, and Oil Are Different Inputs
paragraphs: A working shoreline collector can still fail at a Chemical Lake or oil source when the storage path is wrong. Test each liquid with its intended storage route and never diagnose three liquids through one complicated farm machine.

If one apparently valid water edge refuses to register after mode, height, connection, and capacity checks, move the intake a few metres and repeat the direct-container test. Treat that as a location workaround after the build has passed every other check.

name: Water Cannon and Water Container
description: A storage-and-delivery pair for moving water into farm machines, defensive systems, and repeatable mechanisms.
imageAlt: water system image from Scrap Mechanic

tables.caption: Watering chain check
rows: Vacuum Pump is In and aimed at water
Water Cannon has a water supply
Sensor or Controller sends the expected signal

sections.heading: Separate Storage from Aiming
paragraphs: Mount the Water Container where its mass is stable and the Cannon where it can reach the target. A compact farm machine is easier to tune when refilling, aiming, and activation are treated as separate problems.
bullets: Test coverage on the nearest and farthest crop row.
Prove the cannon with a manual Button before using Sensors or Controllers.
Keep a Water Bucket nearby for recovery.
If the pump works but the cannon does not, inspect the water supply and trigger as separate connections.

name: Large Chest
description: High-capacity storage that can serve as vehicle cargo, base organization, and a connected logistics container.
imageAlt: large chest image from Scrap Mechanic

facts.label: Use for
facts.value: Base stock, cargo, and connected systems

sections.heading: Storage Needs a Retrieval Rule
paragraphs: Use separate chests for building material, food and seeds, electronics, fuel, and expedition equipment. On vehicles, mount heavy storage low and inside the wheelbase.
bullets: Label the outside with paint or a sample block.
Leave an empty chest for unloading a complete expedition.
Do not make the only supply chest part of an untested vehicle.

name: Craftbot, Refinebot, Cookbot, and Dressbot
description: Mechanic Station workshop chain: Dispenserbot creates the portable stations, Craftbot upgrades from 2 to 8 slots (Level 5 costs 20 Component Kits for ~2× speed), Refinebot processes resources, Cookbot makes perk food, Dressbot handles garments.
imageAlt: Crafting station bots from Scrap Mechanic

properties.label: Refinebot role
properties.value: Resource objects → refined materials; auto-pull from nearby collectors

properties.label: Automation
properties.value: Large Chests + Vacuum Pipes for input/output loops

tables.caption: Craftbot upgrade costs and slots
tables.note: Level 5 speed has engine rounding quirks on very short recipes—expect about one second longer than a perfect half-time on some items.

tables.caption: Station roles versus bottlenecks
rows: Slots, then Component Kits for upgrades
Single output slot — pipe into chests

sections.heading: Dispenserbot Is the Gate
paragraphs: After restoring the Mechanic Station, the static Dispenserbot creates portable Craftbot, Refinebot, Cookbot, and Dressbot units. Create Craftbot first; add Refinebot when raw nodes clog storage; add Cookbot before Warehouse and mining trips that need perk food.

sections.heading: Spend Component Kits on Slots, Then Speed
paragraphs: Early kits are better spent unlocking Craftbot slots than cosmetics. Levels 2–4 are five kits each for two slots. Save a twenty-kit stack for Level 5 once the workshop already has labeled input/output chests—speed without organization just fills the wrong pile faster.

sections.heading: Refinebot Wants Pipes
paragraphs: Refinebots pull from nearby Resource Collectors and choke on a single output slot. Connect Large Chests with Vacuum Pipes or port contact so refined material leaves automatically. Expect on the order of a few minutes to empty a full collector—batch refine instead of babysitting one log at a time.

sections.heading: Cookbot Is Loadout, Not Flavor
paragraphs: In 1.0, cooked food restores health and grants perks. Stage a combat meal and a travel meal before Farmbot, Warehouse, or Excavation Island runs. Keep seed potatoes separate from ammo potatoes and from Cookbot ingredients.

sections.heading: 1.0 Schematics Gate Recipes
paragraphs: Some Craftbot recipes stay locked until Schematic Boxes / Schematicbot progression. If an older guide lists a part you cannot craft, check schematic unlocks before farming materials for a phantom recipe.
